manager: אנליסט אי.אמ.אס. ניהול קרנות בנאמנות (1986) בע"מ
legal_form: קרן סגורה, קרן סל (Israeli ETF under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994); קרן בלתי מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; קרן להשקעות חוץ (מטבע עיקרי) שהמטבע העיקרי שלה דולר ארה"ב; units of 1 ₪ par value; 'ATF' = Analyst Tracking Fund (report footnote 3); units first offered to the public on 08.04.2025 (this is the fund's first annual report); kosher approval in force from 29.03.2026 (footnote 6). Trustee: מזרחי טפחות חברה לנאמנות בע"מ. REPLICATION: futures and swaps: mainly futures abroad on the tracking asset and swaps on it, with FX forwards and spot (annual report https://mayafiles.tase.co.il/rpdf/1732001-1733000/P1732353-00.pdf, p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'ניהול השקעות הקרן מתאפיין בעיקר בביצוע עסקאות בחוזים עתידיים בחו"ל על נכס המעקב, בעסקאות החלף על נכס המעקב'; read 2026-10-25).

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee (דמי ניהול קבועים): p. 1 'שכר מנהל הקרן: 0% מהשווי הנקי השנתי הממוצע של נכסי הקרן' (footnote 9: the manager committed to the ISA outline not to raise its pay during a calendar year; it may raise it only on 01.01.2027). Expense table (08.04.2025 to 31.12.2025): fixed management fee 0.00%. Main prospectus published on Magna on 22.07.2025, reference 2025-03-054399 (Magna returns 403 to scripts; the prospectus itself was not opened). ISIN IL0012189168 and the TASE symbol 'אנלט.ס1' were read on TASE's security page (https://market.tase.co.il/he/market_data/security/1218916/major_data, fields 'ISIN' and 'סימול', read in Chrome on 2026-10-24); the annual report prints neither. The Maya fund page shows no data for ETFs.

variable_management.notes: Variable management fee rate (שיעור דמי ניהול משתנים): p. 1 '0.2%' (footnote 10: the manager may change the rate on 01.01.2027). The mechanism works in both directions (ETF-14); the expense table shows the variable fee for 08.04.2025 to 31.12.2025 as -0.20% of average net assets, a payment from the manager to the fund, not a charge to it. The rate is below the 0.30% creation/redemption category cap (ETF-14); copied as printed.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. For 08.04.2025 to 31.12.2025 the report prints the fund's price return 16.97% (standard deviation 19.22) against the tracking asset (S&P 500 100%, דולר ארה"ב 100%) 17.43% (standard deviation 20.15). The difference is not computed here (data-update rule). Added 2026-10-25: the third-party page the report points to (chart.bursagraph.co.il / fundscenter.co.il, 'Funds Center' by Guideline) publishes the 12-month tracking difference under ETF-07(e), but states 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here; founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: No median bid-ask spread is printed. The report prints the differences between unit value and exchange price for 08.04.2025 to 31.12.2025: range -190.17 to 589.01 agorot, average 1.85 agorot (a premium/discount measure, ETF-06). Spread data is published by the manager elsewhere (ETF-07; the report points to fundscenter.co.il, a third-party page, not read). Creation fee 0.30% and redemption fee 0.30% on direct orders through a TASE member (p. 1).

fund_level_withholding_drag.notes: Not collected: no computation is made here and the report prints no withholding figure. The fund may take its exposure through derivatives and index products (investment policy, p. 2); any dividend-withholding drag sits inside instrument pricing and is not published as a rate.
